#16 and some literature on fermionic and anyonic tensor network methods

… for fermionic systems using super vector spaces:

  • Quinten Mortier, Lukas Devos, Lander Burgelman, Bram Vanhecke, Nick Bultinck, Frank Verstraete, Jutho Haegeman, Laurens Vanderstraeten, Fermionic tensor network methods, SciPost Physics 18(1), 012 (2025) (doi:10.21468/SciPostPhys.18.1.012)

… for anyonic models:

  • Robert N. C. Pfeifer, Philippe Corboz, Oliver Buerschaper, Miguel Aguado, Matthias Troyer, Guifre Vidal, Simulation of anyons with tensor network algorithms, Phys. Rev. B 82, 115126 (2010) (doi:10.1103/PhysRevB.82.115126)

  • Robert N. C. Pfeifer, Simulation of anyons using symmetric tensor network algorithms (arXiv:1202.1522)

  • Babatunde M. Ayeni, Sukhwinder Singh, Robert N. C. Pfeifer, Gavin K. Brennen, Simulation of braiding anyons using matrix product states, Phys. Rev. B 93, 165128 (2016) (doi:10.1103/PhysRevB.93.165128)
